description: This file defines types, interfaces, and functions for handling 'PolyVinyl' objects, which represent challenge files with properties like name, extension, contents, and metadata. It includes utilities for creating, validating, transforming, and managing challenge file objects within a TypeScript codebase.

methods.name: createPoly
methods.description: Creates a PolyVinyl object with provided properties, ensuring types and generating path and fileKey.

methods.name: isPoly
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object conforms to the ChallengeFile interface.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets new contents and optional source in a ChallengeFile object.

methods.name: regenerateMissingProperties
methods.description: Reconstructs a ChallengeFile object with default head, tail, and path if missing.

methods.name: clearHeadTail
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the head and tail of a ChallengeFile.

methods.name: compileHeadTail
methods.description: Concatenates head, contents, and tail with optional padding, then clears head and tail.

methods.name: transformContents
methods.description: Transforms the contents of a ChallengeFile using a wrapper function, preserving source.

methods.name: transformHeadTailAndContents
methods.description: Transforms head, tail, and contents of a ChallengeFile with a wrapper function.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates a source property for a ChallengeFile, defaulting to contents if source is undefined.
